The necklace features alternating large, matte, dark reddish-brown oval beads and smaller, faceted, translucent green crystal beads. A single loose brown bead lies near the center loop. The strand forms a U-shape, suggesting it is draped or laid out.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The stringing material seems to disappear or merge ambiguously into the beads at the tightest curve of the loop. The physical connection between the green and brown beads in the lower left loop lacks clear structural logic, appearing slightly fused or floating.

The surface texture of the large brown beads is overly smooth and plastic-like, lacking the subtle micro-scratches or natural variations expected in wood, stone, or glass. The specular highlights are soft and diffuse rather than sharp.
The loose brown bead in the middle appears to hover slightly above the plane of the necklace without a clear shadow grounding it, creating a minor depth inconsistency.
